sections.title: Anti-Cheat
sections.intro: Some players, or everyone, must run the Anti-Cheat to play. Download it on the Anti-Cheat page of this site.

commands.description: Tells you, privately, whether the Anti-Cheat is on and whether you must use it. If you must and yours is not running, it also gives you the download link.
Votes to require the Anti-Cheat for everyone in this match.
notes: Only in the ready-up of the first round of the first map, with both teams full and no mix running.
The vote lasts 20 s and passes with more than half of the team players.
If it passes, it stays on until the match ends, or until the server has been empty for 10 minutes. Whoever must use it and does not have it open goes to the spectators.
After a failed vote, wait 60 s before trying again.

sections.title: Queue and slots
sections.intro: When the server is full, spectators wait in a queue for a slot in the teams. The queue is fair: whoever arrived first plays first.

commands.description: Shows the queue: who is waiting for a slot, in order.
Claims a free slot in a team for you.
notes: In the ready-up of a new game (score 0x0), any spectator can claim a slot.
During a game, only players from the teams that started it can claim one, to come back in place of a substitute. If the substitute is the Tank at that moment, wait until the Tank is over.
It does not work when the round is over, for about 60 s while the teams are arranged after a new game, during a mix, or while your lerp is invalid.
The same player can claim a slot at most 2 times before the game goes live.
If you disconnect, you keep your place for 300 s (5 minutes).

sections.title: Mix
sections.intro: A mix makes two new teams: two captains pick the players one by one. There are a few ways to start one.

commands.title: Rules for every mix
commands.description: These rules apply to every way of starting a mix on this page.
notes: Only in the ready-up of a new game (score 0x0).
Both teams must be full, and it cannot be 1v1.
Spectators cannot start a mix, and no other mix or vote can be running.
During the mix nobody can join a team without being picked.
Leaving during a mix gives a warning the first time and then a 60-minute ban.
`!kickspecs` is blocked during a mix and for 40 s after it.

commands.description: Votes to start a mix with elected captains. It starts after 2 votes; each later mix in the same ready-up needs 2 more votes. First everyone votes for the captains in a menu, then the captains pick their players in turns, also in a menu.
Proposes a mix with the two captains you name. A 20 s Yes/No vote starts and passes with more than half of the votes. Captain 1 goes to the Survivors and captain 2 to the Infected.

examples.text: vorkyss is the Survivors captain and Feeh the Infected captain.

notes: Type the exact name or the start of it. Names with spaces go between quotes.

commands.description: A balanced mix: same rules and votes as `!mix`, but the site splits the players into two even teams using the community ranking. The result shows in the chat as "Survivors: …" and "Infected: …".
notes: If someone is not ranked yet, the server says who and suggests `!mix` instead.
If the site cannot be reached, the server suggests `!mix`.

sections.title: Campaigns and ending a game
sections.intro: Choose the next campaign or end a game that is already decided.

commands.description: Opens a menu with the campaigns installed on the server, in alphabetical order, and starts a vote to change to the one you choose.
notes: It uses the game's own vote, so there is a 30 s wait between votes.
Spectators cannot vote while the game is paused.

commands.description: Votes for your team to give up the game.
notes: From the 2nd map on, with the round live for at least 10 s. Not in the ready-up.
It needs a strict majority of your team. Not voting counts as No.
If it fails, wait 60 s before trying again.
If it passes, the other team gets the higher score plus 250, the rounds are finished automatically so the result reaches the ranking, and the next campaign starts.

commands.title: "Game decided, keep playing?"
commands.description: On the 4th map of a campaign longer than 4 maps, in the 2nd round, when one team is 15 points or more ahead, or the team that is behind can no longer catch up, the server asks the losing team whether to keep playing.
notes: It waits while a Tank is alive or a survivor is incapacitated.
Only the human players of the losing team vote, for 15 s. The game goes on if at least half of them vote Yes; not voting counts as No.
On No, the game ends: the next campaign is announced, everyone is slain after 5 s and the server changes to that campaign.

sections.title: Voice while spectating
sections.intro: Choose whose voice you hear while you watch.

commands.description: Chooses whose voice you hear while you watch, besides the other spectators, whom you always hear. Without an option, a menu opens with your current choice marked.

examples.text: You hear the Infected team and the spectators.

notes: Short forms also work: `surv` or `2` for the Survivors, `infec`, `zombie` or `3` for the Infected, `spec` or `1` for the spectators only, `everyone` or `0` for all.
It goes back to `all` at every map change.
It has no effect while all-talk is on.

sections.title: Site, ranking and skins
sections.intro: The game server talks to this site: open the ranking without leaving the game and use the skins you bought.

commands.description: Opens the ranking of this site inside the game.
notes: It also opens by itself 60 s after you join a new game.
A reminder shows in the chat every 200 s.

commands.description: Opens this list of commands inside the game, in the same panel as the ranking.
Equips the weapon skins you own. Buy them on the Skins page of this site with the stars you earn as MVP. Alone, `!skin` shows the help.

examples.text: The next of your skins for the weapon in your hands.
The pump shotgun goes back to the default look.

notes: Works only while the server has the skins turned on.
You must own the skin.
Weapons: smg, mac, mp5, pump, chrome, magnum (or deagle), axe, katana, machete, bat, cricket, guitar, crowbar, golf, pan.
Downloads of server content must be allowed in your game. A skin you buy shows up from the next map change.

commands.title: Patents above the heads
commands.description: When the server turns them on, each player's patent (rank) shows above their head. There is no command for it.

sections.title: Automatic server rules
sections.intro: No command for these, but every player should know them.

commands.title: Friendly fire control
commands.description: Shooting your teammates over and over gets you kicked and pauses the game. Damage is not counted when the teammate is low on health, incapacitated or pinned.

commands.title: AFK in the ready-up
commands.description: A player who is AFK in the ready-up goes to the spectators: after 180 s in a new game, or 360 s in a game in progress. This only happens when someone is waiting for a slot.

commands.title: No spectating while the Tank is alive
commands.description: While the Tank is alive you cannot go to the spectators, unless the game is paused. The server reminds you: "use !pause to change team".

commands.title: No spectating right after damage
commands.description: If you took damage in the last 5 s, you cannot go to the spectators.

commands.title: Invalid lerp
commands.description: If your lerp is out of the allowed range, the server warns you. Paste this line in the console (~) to fix it:

commands.title: Fixed names
commands.description: Some players have a name set by the admins, and the server keeps that name in the game.

commands.title: All-talk in the first ready-up
commands.description: During the first ready-up of a game, everyone hears everyone, so the teams can be arranged.

commands.title: "Tank in N%"
commands.description: The chat warns when the Tank is getting close, with the % of the map where it spawns.

commands.title: No fake chat
commands.description: Messages made to look like they came from the server or from another player are blocked.

sections.title: How to type commands
sections.intro: Commands are typed in the game chat (Y for everyone, U for your team) or in the console (~). These basics work for every command on this page.

commands.description: Start the command with an exclamation mark in the chat. The command runs and everyone sees what you typed.
The same command with a slash instead runs silently: nothing of what you typed shows in the chat.
In the console (~), type the command with `sm_` in front instead of the exclamation mark. Handy for binding a command to a key.

commands.title: Names with spaces
commands.description: When a player name has spaces or symbols, put it between double quotes so the server reads it as one name.

examples.text: (LoD) Adeilson and Feeh are the captains.

commands.title: Ready keys
commands.description: When no vote is running, F1 marks you as ready and F2 takes it back. While a vote is running, the same keys answer Yes and No.
Lists the commands you are allowed to use on the server, in the console.

commands.title: Talk to the admins
commands.description: In the team chat (U), start the message with `@` and it goes to the admins who are online, even if they are in another team.

examples.code: @ a player is AFK and blocking the game

sections.title: Match, configs and votes
sections.intro: Load a competitive config, set where the bosses spawn or set the score. Most of these start a vote.

commands.description: Votes to load a match config. Without a name, a menu with the configs opens.
notes: Spectators cannot start it. The vote lasts 20 s, and it cannot start while players are still connecting.
Common configs: zonemod, zoneretro, zm3v3, zm2v2, zm1v1, neomod and others.

commands.description: Votes to switch the loaded config to another one. Same rules as `!match`.
Votes to unload the current config. Same rules as `!match`.
Votes to change where the Tank and the Witch spawn on this map, in % of the map.

examples.text: Tank at 50%, the Witch stays where it is.

notes: Only in the ready-up of the first round of a map.
0 means no spawn, -1 keeps the current one.
Maps with fixed boss spawns refuse the change.
In ZoneMod the Witch value is ignored.

commands.description: Votes to set the score of each team, for example to continue a game that was interrupted.
notes: Needs at least 2 players.

commands.description: Votes to kick the spectators from the server.
notes: Blocked during a mix and for 40 s after it.

commands.title: Vote kick
commands.description: The game's vote kick is turned off on this server. If someone is causing trouble, tell the admins: team chat starting with `@`.

sections.title: Ready-up and pause
sections.intro: Before each round everyone gets ready; during the round any team can pause the game.

commands.description: Marks you as ready. When everyone is ready, a 3 s countdown starts the round.
notes: F1 does the same when no vote is running.

commands.description: Takes your ready back. During the countdown it cancels it.
notes: F2 does the same when no vote is running.

commands.description: Switches between ready and not ready. Good for binding to a single key.
Hides or shows the ready-up panel on your screen.
Takes you back to the start area if you got stuck during the ready-up.
Pauses the game. There is no limit of pauses.
notes: Spectators cannot vote while the game is paused.

commands.description: Marks your team as ready to go on. When both teams are ready, a 3 s countdown resumes the game; `!unready` cancels it.

commands.title: Automatic pause
commands.description: If a player crashes during a live round, the game pauses by itself so they can come back.

sections.title: Teams and spectators
sections.intro: Change team and watch the game.

commands.description: Moves you to the spectators.
notes: Not while you are pinned by an infected.
The Tank cannot go to spectators.
A living infected is killed first.
See also the automatic rules below: not while the Tank is alive, and not if you took damage in the last 5 s.

commands.title: Join a team
commands.description: Press M to open the team menu, or type in the console `jointeam 2` for the Survivors or `jointeam 3` for the Infected.
Registers you as a caster, someone who narrates or streams the game. Anyone can register.
notes: Reconnect after registering to be able to use your addons.
Casters cannot join a team until they unregister.

commands.description: Removes your caster registration, so you can play again.
Turns the spectator panel on or off, with the health and status of every player.
Turns the Tank panel on or off: who controls the Tank, its health and its frustration.

commands.title: Spectator fly speed
commands.description: Console commands that change how fast the free camera flies while you spectate. The speed multiplier goes from 0 to 2 and starts at 1.0, the normal speed. While flying, Use (E) goes up and Reload (R) goes down.

examples.text: A key that speeds up by the step (0.1 by default).

notes: `sm_set_specspeed_increment` sets how much `sm_increase_specspeed` and `sm_decrease_specspeed` change the speed each time; it starts at 0.1.
`sm_set_vertical_increment` sets how fast E and R move you up and down; it starts at 450.
A multiplier outside 0 to 2 is ignored. Your speed is applied again every time you join the spectators.

sections.title: In-game information
sections.intro: Ask the server about the bosses, the score, the network settings and the statistics of the round.

commands.description: Shows who will be the Tank (everyone sees it), at what % of the map the Tank and the Witch spawn, and the current %.
notes: There is no Witch in ZoneMod.

commands.description: Shows how far the survivors have gone on the map, in %.
Shows the bonus the survivors are earning in this round and the damage they took.
Shows the points of the map: distance and maximum bonus.
Lists the lerp of every player.
notes: Allowed lerp: 0 to 67 ms.
You can change it at most 3 times per round; in the ready-up changes are free.
Out of range, you are moved to the spectators.

commands.description: Lists the network settings (rates) of every player.
Shows which config is loaded and what changed in it.
Shows the attributes this config gives a weapon, such as damage and spread. Without a name it shows the weapon in your hands.
notes: Use the weapon name without `weapon_`. Melee weapons work too, such as `katana` or `crowbar`.

commands.description: Shows the statistics of the round or of the whole game: MVP, skill, friendly fire, accuracy and infected.

examples.text: The MVP of the whole game.

commands.description: Shortcuts for `!stats`: `!mvp` the MVP, `!mvpme` only your own line, `!skill` the skill, `!ff` the friendly fire and `!acc` the accuracy.
Chooses which statistics are shown to you by themselves at the end of each round.

sections.title: While playing
sections.intro: Helpers for the infected, the Tank and the survivors during the round.

commands.description: While you are an infected ghost, teleports you to a survivor. 1 is the survivor furthest ahead.

examples.text: Goes to the survivor furthest ahead.

notes: Characters: nick, rochelle, coach, ellis, bill, zoey, louis, francis.

commands.description: Chooses the Tank's rock throw. You can also hold a key while throwing: Reload for the two-handed overhand, Use for the underhand and M2 for the one-handed overhand.
notes: Punch-rock and jump-rock are blocked.

commands.description: Turns on or off switching to the melee weapon by itself when you pick one up.

sections.title: Fun
sections.intro: Settle a discussion, draw a number or pick a side.

commands.description: Flips a coin: heads or tails, for everyone to see.
Rolls a die. It has 20 sides unless you say otherwise.
Draws a team for you: Survivors or Infected.

sections.title: Other server rules
sections.intro: Smaller things the server does by itself.

commands.title: Connection messages
commands.description: The chat announces who is connecting to the server and who left.

commands.title: Dropped items glow
commands.description: Weapons and items dropped on the ground glow, so they are easy to find.

sections.title: For administrators
sections.intro: Commands that only the server admins can use. Players do not need them.

commands.description: `!aac on` and `!aac off` turn the Anti-Cheat requirement on or off until an admin changes it again or a vote turns it on; `!aac off` also cancels one turned on by a vote. `!aac config`, `mode`, `add`, `remove` and `list` show and change who must use it; the site's Anti-Cheat settings follow the change.
notes: Only root admins can use it.

commands.description: Stops the mix in progress.

When an admin uses it, the mix starts at once with no vote, even from the spectators. With one name, that player is the Survivors captain and the other is chosen by vote; with two names, both captains are set.
When an admin uses it, the balanced mix starts at once with no vote, even from the spectators.

Opens a menu to add campaigns to the queue of next campaigns, or to clear it. The queue is used when a game ends early, by a surrender or a decided game; when it is empty, the next campaign is drawn at random.
`!listcampaigns` lists in the console every installed campaign; `!refreshcampaigns` reads the list again after a campaign is added.
Turns broadcast mode on or off: while it is on, everyone hears your voice.
Turns the weapon skins on or off on this server.
Gives the Tank to the chosen player.
Draws again, at random, who will be the Tank.
Adds health to every living survivor: 100 unless you give another amount from 1 to 100. Health never goes above 100, and incapacitated survivors are picked up.
Changes the number of player slots on the server. Players cannot change it on this server.
`!swap` moves players to the other team, `!swapto` moves them to a team (1 spectators, 2 Survivors, 3 Infected) and `!swapteams` swaps the two teams.
notes: A player sent to the spectators with `!swapto 1` cannot join a team for 60 s.

commands.description: Starts the round without waiting for everyone to be ready.
Pauses or resumes the game at once, without the teams.
Sets where the Tank or the Witch spawns, with no vote.
`!forcematch` loads a config with no vote; `!resetmatch` unloads it.
`!caster` registers a player as a caster; `!resetcasters` clears every caster.
Lists in the console the fun admin commands of the server.
The usual SourceMod commands: kick, ban, mute the voice, block the chat, kill a player and change the map. `!admin` opens all of them in a menu.
